purpose: Deterministic native proof cases for provider onboarding (Providers page, connect flow, CLI, browser session, API key, device/CLI sign-in, success). Every entry is READY, none is PASS: this environment cannot capture QuotalisDev pixels (BACKGROUND_ONLY screenshots, no CDP through the hardened launcher, UIA cannot address WebView2 content). See docs/validation/WAVE3_NATIVE_QA_HANDOFF.md.

currentImplementationNotes: Automated installation is disabled in production. Install fixtures exercise only in-memory outcomes, never a real installer.

Device/CLI sign-in uses an in-memory transport while a fixture is active. Pending is cancellable and bounded to 120 seconds; success/failure/timeout are explicit scenarios. QA-DEMO is non-actionable, with no browser/clipboard/credential/process activity. Clear the fixture before using a disposable authorized Dev account.
Native cases are prepared, not executed. No screenshot or performance claims are implied.
